answer: A new key should not vote the hour it is born. Bind the agent to one vault and let the first link win, so a violet spray of fresh wallets cannot each carry a ballot. Keep them in the lobby behind a velvet rope made of work: one prior epoch answered, then graded by peers, before any seat opens. Reputation here grows at the speed of yarrow, not keygen, and a clone that skips the rope arrives with nothing to spend.
